historical_validation.meaning: The archive preserves November 16-17 validation claims, tested SHAs and open gates. They are historical evidence and are not substituted for current-head Linux/native/provider checks. Completion percentages are not imported into this report.

conclusions: The old local directories are absent, but their source is not lost: exact Git objects and 48 preserved refs are available in this verified archive.

All fifteen archive module trees differ from the selected tested targets. Seven selected targets are ancestors of the corresponding archive heads; eight histories diverge. This does not establish that every archive change is absent from current published work.

Previously described missing implementations must be checked against recovered services, persistence and interfaces before any reimplementation. Existing expanded published designs must not be overwritten wholesale.
The original 114-head inventory and subsequent 122-head remote snapshot remain frozen. These 48 private archive refs are a separate recovery population, not additional advertised remote heads.
All module activation and normal review/CI/ownership gates remain in force. No archived source was published or integrated by this inventory.
